scene: public EPIC-KITCHENS P03_28 egocentric bottle workspace

actions.label: place-bottle-rack
actions.instruction: Starting with the blue bottle held in the right robot hand, move it to the dish rack, stabilize it with both robot hands, lower it into the rack, release only after support, and retract both arms.

phases.name: stabilize
phases.description: preserve the initial right-hand bottle grasp

phases.name: approach-rack
phases.description: carry the upright blue bottle toward the visible dish rack while the left gripper approaches

phases.name: lower
phases.description: use both grippers to lower the bottle vertically into a free rack slot

phases.name: release
phases.description: open both grippers only after the rack supports the bottle

phases.name: retract
phases.description: retract both empty robot arms while the bottle remains stationary in the rack

actions.label: unscrew-bottle-cap
actions.instruction: Starting with the blue bottle held in the right robot hand, bring it to the center, stabilize the bottle with the right gripper, twist the cap counterclockwise with the left gripper, lift the separated cap, and display the open bottle and cap.

phases.name: stabilize
phases.description: preserve the initial right-hand bottle grasp

phases.name: center-bottle
phases.description: bring the upright blue bottle to the center without releasing it

phases.name: grasp-cap
phases.description: close the left gripper on the bottle cap while the right gripper stabilizes the bottle body

phases.name: unscrew
phases.description: rotate the left wrist counterclockwise through several visible turns without rotating the bottle body

phases.name: remove-cap
phases.description: lift the separated cap vertically with the left gripper while the right gripper holds the open bottle

phases.name: display
phases.description: separate the grippers and visibly display the open bottle in the right hand and cap in the left

actions.label: rinse-bottle
actions.instruction: Starting with the blue bottle held in the right robot hand, move it under the faucet, use the left robot hand to operate the faucet, rotate the bottle through several rinsing orientations under the water stream, then move it away while keeping the grasp.

phases.name: stabilize
phases.description: preserve the initial right-hand bottle grasp

phases.name: move-under-faucet
phases.description: move the bottle directly below the visible faucet

phases.name: open-faucet
phases.description: reach the faucet control with the left gripper while the right gripper holds the bottle below

phases.name: rinse
phases.description: rotate and sweep the bottle through several visible orientations under the water stream

phases.name: remove-from-water
phases.description: return the bottle upright and move it away from the faucet

phases.name: hold
phases.description: hold the rinsed bottle above the basin without releasing it
